svg.title: Chapter 4: the Baspa valley
svg.desc: The Baspa valley from the Karcham turn-off to the road end beyond Chitkul, with the footpath towards Lamkhaga La. Places: Karcham, Sangla, Kamru, Batseri, Rakcham, Chitkul, Lamkhaga La (off the map, south-east).
svg.text: Kinner Kailash massif to the north
